data.headline: Apple-Linked Tech Stocks Are Hard-Hit in Asia
data.summary: Two of Asia’s biggest technology names—both with deep links to Apple—were especially hard-hit in the Asian market plunge Monday.  Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing, which makes chips for Apple’s iPhones and other products, and Foxconn, which assembles the phones, both were down about 10%.
